execution.cache_policy: Each fresh CLI sample and native session uses a new process; warm repetitions share that session's resident engine. OS file-page-cache state is uncontrolled; no destructive cache flush or purge is performed.

semantics.engine_create: Total kokoro_engine_create time, including pack open and validation, voice validation, and stage creation.
semantics.model_pack_open: Separate kokoro_pack_open call, including mmap and full tensor-payload SHA-256 validation; not subtracted from engine creation.
semantics.cold_cli_end_to_end: Parent wall time for a fresh CLI process through WAV file close; includes frontend, engine creation, synthesis, and WAV writing. OS file-page-cache state is uncontrolled.
semantics.cold_native_session: Each session starts a fresh native driver process and measures its first request before warmup; OS file-page-cache state is uncontrolled, so this does not mean cold storage.
semantics.first_audio_availability: Complete in-memory waveform after all input chunks are synthesized and combined; no streaming.
semantics.warm_request: English frontend or IPA tokenization, native synthesis, and full waveform combination; WAV writing is excluded.
semantics.wav_write_completion: kokoro_wav_write_pcm16 returned after closing the file; no fsync/durability claim.
semantics.stage_timing: Benchmark-only monotonic timestamps around the seven existing inference-stage calls. This adds two monotonic clock reads and one accumulator callback per stage per chunk; that instrumentation is included in total synthesis time and the residual other_synthesis_overhead, so stage shares are approximate.

workloads.name: paragraph
workloads.source_text: Good morning. I can help you organize the meeting notes, summarize the main decisions, and draft a clear follow-up for everyone who joined.
